scenario: [LINT.7.1]: an interval with `start == end` is empty and legal, so `t.x in (5 .. 5)` compiles; equal literal endpoints are not LINT.7.4's inverted pair. That it admits no point is runtime/LINT.9.5.runtime's. LINT.9.5, the id, is a tombstone.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    x: Int key

rule empty_interval:
    Trig t where t.x in (5 .. 5)
->
    log info "never fires"
